changes: Regular capture scan and per-target timeout defaults are 60 seconds across settings validation, UI and execution fallbacks; saved custom values retained.
Bulk completion-history clearing resets CAPTURED rows even when this session retains verified artifacts. Artifact files and snapshots remain intact.
cause: Bulk clear explicitly preserved targets with verified current-session artifacts; privacy mode was unrelated. Single-target clear already reset those markers.

verification.scope: Defaults, bulk clear with privacy both on/off, retained artifacts/files, table refresh, settings save/reopen, status colors, history availability and capture rounds.

compatibility: No new router command or parameter; only defaults within existing accepted bounds and local state-reset semantics changed.
